comparison.objective: Fit a smartphone into a hybrid case in the correct orientation and snap all corners under the lip.
comparison.physical_skill: Orient a thin fragile object, align an asymmetric camera feature, and sequentially press corners through compliant latches.
comparison.success_condition: All four corners are seated under the lip with the phone correctly oriented and the case flat, released, and still.
comparison.reason: This is compliant snap-fit insertion with orientation constraints, not threaded countertorque or functional setting verification.
